path_canonicalization_profile.sequence_rule: as_sequence与confederation_sequence内ASN顺序和prepend重复均原样保留
path_canonicalization_profile.set_rule: as_set与confederation_set内ASN按数值升序稳定排序且不去重
path_canonicalization_profile.segment_type_rule: segment_type进入摘要且不得拍平、合并或转换
path_canonicalization_profile.encoding_rule: 对规范化segment数组执行RFC8785 canonical JSON UTF-8编码

common_value_state_contract.empty: 合法完整查询得到零成员；returned_count=0且total_count=0
common_value_state_contract.unknown: 来源明确记录字段或状态未知，不能改写为零
common_value_state_contract.missing: 预期人口中缺少记录，必须携带missing_reason
common_value_state_contract.unavailable: 来源或能力不可查询，只返回失败/能力回执，不得生成ResultSet
common_value_state_contract.audit_only: 仅审计层存在且当前权限不可读取，只返回失败/能力回执
common_value_state_contract.failed: 失败只返回ToolRunReceipt，不返回可发布ResultSet

page_token.description: 第一页必须为null；非空token绑定identity/query/sort/source digest

path_asn_membership_profile.membership_rule: 对typed path_segments中全部segment的ASN token取成员集合；prepend重复只在索引成员集合内去重，不修改主路径

filter_profile.contains_asn_rule: 对source view已物化typed path_segments中全部ASN token建立成员索引；prepend重复只在索引成员集合内去重，不修改主路径
filter_profile.anchor_before_known_origin_rule: 仅索引ordered_sequence_eligible=true、origin_status=known、observed_origin_asn=known_origin_asn、且去除连续prepend后known origin是AS_PATH最后ASN并严格位于anchor之后的source row
filter_profile.anchor_population_rule: anchor必须属于同publication已冻结完整ever-affected-AS ResultSet；物化回执原样绑定该ResultSet身份、manifest/content/freeze摘要及完整排序ASN成员摘要

tools.evidence_contract: 每个member引用cohort artifact、member row与source digest

contains_asn_filter_contract.returned_member_validation: 每个返回行必须满足eligible predicate且typed path_segments确实包含target ASN；这只验证包含关系，不重算索引总体完整性
contains_asn_filter_contract.completeness_proof: 完整性仅由Host可信index/materialization/query receipt链证明

tools.active_path_rule: 只有visibility=visible且common_path_status属于ordered或unordered的path可称该时点活动观测路径
tools.invisible_path_rule: 当前origin/path为not_applicable；历史最后路径若提供必须单独命名并带时间
tools.evidence_contract: 每行引用materialized row、checkpoint、projection receipt和source manifest；contains_asn查询额外绑定可信membership index、materialization与query filter receipt

tools.single_responsibility: 读取绑定publication的一种窗口级path-association evidence事实人口

input_contract.filter_contract: contains_asn与anchor_before_known_origin只读取source view预物化索引；query-time路径解析或LLM过滤禁止

association_population_domain.row_generation_rule: 每个eligible anchor、known origin、cohort member prefix和canonical path association生成一行
association_population_domain.contains_asn_completeness: 只保证在该窗口级association人口内完整，不保证RRC25原始全部路径人口
association_population_domain.q20_required_wording: 完整列出绑定publication窗口级path-association人口中包含该ASN的记录

native_filter_contract.returned_member_validation: contains_asn时typed path_segments必须包含target；anchor-before时row.anchor_asn等于target、ordered_sequence_eligible=true、origin_status=known、observed_origin_asn=known_origin_asn、path_segments全为as_sequence，去除连续prepend后known origin必须是末尾ASN且anchor严格早于该origin
native_filter_contract.completeness_proof: complete ResultSet的稳定成员键摘要与可信索引匹配人口摘要逐项相等

tools.evidence_contract: 每行引用path association artifact、path identity与source manifest
